name: maltodextrin
description: Maltodextrin is a carbohydrate made from starch. It is commonly used as a thickener, filler, or texture modifier in processed foods.
purpose: Used to improve texture, consistency, and volume.

name: citric acid
description: Citric acid is an organic acid naturally found in citrus fruits. It is commonly used in foods as an acidity regulator and preservative.
purpose: Used to control acidity and improve flavor stability.

name: sodium benzoate
description: Sodium benzoate is a preservative used to help prevent the growth of certain microorganisms in foods and beverages.
purpose: Used to extend shelf life and preserve products.

name: lecithin
description: Lecithin is a substance commonly obtained from soy or sunflower sources. It is often used as an emulsifier to help ingredients mix together.
purpose: Used to stabilize mixtures and improve texture.

name: ascorbic acid
description: Ascorbic acid is another name for vitamin C. In food products it can be used as an antioxidant and to help maintain product quality.
purpose: Used as an antioxidant and food-quality agent.
